prompt.content:
You are a power system operator finding an N-1 SECURE least-cost dispatch.

Network: 5 buses (bus 0 is the slack/reference bus).

Transmission lines (DC power flow; bus angles theta in radians; the MW flow on a line from bus i to bus j is: flow_MW = 100 * (theta_i - theta_j) / reactance_pu; limits apply to |flow_MW| in both directions):
  Line 0: bus 0 <-> bus 2, reactance 0.3514 p.u., normal rating 103.9 MW, emergency rating 109.1 MW
  Line 1: bus 0 <-> bus 3, reactance 0.1312 p.u., normal rating 42.0 MW, emergency rating 89.3 MW
  Line 2: bus 0 <-> bus 4, reactance 0.1031 p.u., normal rating 82.4 MW, emergency rating 184.6 MW
  Line 3: bus 1 <-> bus 2, reactance 0.374 p.u., normal rating 36.6 MW, emergency rating 38.4 MW
  Line 4: bus 3 <-> bus 4, reactance 0.1865 p.u., normal rating 49.9 MW, emergency rating 93.7 MW

Generators:
  Gen 0: at bus 2, cost $45.67/MWh, output range [17.9, 163.7] MW
  Gen 1: at bus 3, cost $59.1/MWh, output range [4.3, 212.4] MW

Loads:
  Bus 0: 95.8 MW
  Bus 3: 50.1 MW
  Bus 4: 79.1 MW

Find the dispatch that minimizes total cost ($/h) such that:
1. Total generation equals total load (225.0 MW)
2. Each generator stays within its output range
3. With ALL lines in service, no line flow exceeds its NORMAL rating
4. N-1 SECURITY: for EVERY single-line outage that leaves the network connected, the SAME dispatch must remain feasible — after the outage, power reroutes over the remaining lines per DC power flow, and every remaining line's flow must stay within its EMERGENCY rating.

The cheapest dispatch ignoring rule 4 typically loads a corridor that has no margin left when its parallel line trips — you must anticipate every outage, not just the network as built.

Report each MW value to at least one decimal place. Constraints are verified
with a +/-0.5 MW tolerance, but violations inside that tolerance are penalized
in the cost scoring, so target exact feasibility.

Respond with your final answer as JSON on the last line, exactly in this format:
{"dispatch_mw": [<Gen 0 MW>, <Gen 1 MW>, ...]}
